title: MaPLe paired modality Mirror prompt coordinates
hypothesis: For domain-conditioned vision-language prompts, separate visual/textual Givens coordinates over one shared coupled MaPLe prompt state preserve held-out domain-class and base-to-novel quality with less state than independent per-domain MaPLe, and beat matched rank-1 additive modality controls.
scope_deviation: Bounded CPU screen using cached CLIP ViT-B/32, prompt_depth=2 (one deep prompt), 4 CIFAR-10 shots/class, 20 updates/method. This is not an official MaPLe benchmark reproduction; architecture retains its coupled shallow visual projection and deep text/vision prompts.

factorization.mirror_operator: apply Givens rotations across the two prompt-token positions, independently in text and visual streams; visual shallow/deep prompts remain projections of text prompts before the visual rotation
factorization.additive_control: same per-domain two scalar codes applied to learned visual/text low-rank prompt bases

data.heldout_base_class_domain_pairs: for each base class c, withhold all training images from domain c mod 4; each class and each domain remains represented in other observed pairs
data.audit_open: official test images opened only after all prompt states are frozen; all held-out pairs/classes and image hashes recorded

controls: one shared native coupled MaPLe state
independent native coupled MaPLe state per domain
shared MaPLe plus visual/text Givens coordinates
shared MaPLe plus matched visual/text rank-1 additive prompt bases

metrics.quality: mean base accuracy, mean novel accuracy, harmonic mean over class x image-domain cells, and held-out base domain-class pair accuracy
metrics.storage: actual serialized prompt payload bytes and full frozen backbone plus payload bytes
metrics.compute: training wall, full audit inference wall, per-image wall, trainable parameters and prompt-view application MAC proxy

storage.format: UTF-8 JSON inference manifest plus contiguous little-endian float32 arrays
paid_state: all coupled prompt contexts and projections

success_gate: Mirror novel accuracy and H-mean no more than 1 pp below independent MaPLe; at least 25% fewer learned prompt bytes than independent MaPLe; and >=1 pp higher H-mean than additive control.
failure_gate: Additive multimodal low-rank control matches/beats Mirror, or Mirror misses independent-quality tolerance.
boundaries: one update budget and one seed
not official MaPLe reproduction or broad VLM result
final_decision_basis: Mirror misses the required >=1pp H-mean advantage over the rank-1 additive multimodal control (81.27% vs 82.55%) and trails hard-shared MaPLe; independent-bank quality passes the frozen criteria but was trained for five updates/domain.
